kept_items.text: Dario Amodei went on CNN and put a number on it: Half of all entry-level white-collar jobs gone. Unemployment at 10 to 20%. Inside 1 to 5 years.

kept_items.text: Nvidia Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 runs a 27B parameter model on a single GPU using FP4 quantization to shrink memory needs while keeping quality high.

kept_items.author: HighSignal_AI
kept_items.text: Sam Altman says internet tokens are running out; the new plan is models generating their own training data.
kept_items.selection_reason: Substantive framing of Altman argument that pretraining data is running out and the pivot to synthetic data.

kept_items.author: sedielem
kept_items.text: The original scaling laws were wrong due to a bug, which probably led to a lot of wasted compute on oversized undertrained models.
kept_items.selection_reason: Credible practitioner technical observation about a scaling-law bug leading to wasted compute.

kept_items.author: SouthernValue95
kept_items.text: AI is bad for hyperscalers. Meanwhile all are growing EBIT/head 20-50% while spending more on growth capex and R&D than any industrial cycle in history.
kept_items.selection_reason: Counter-narrative financial analysis on hyperscaler AI economics with specific EBIT-per-head figures.

kept_items.author: karpathy
kept_items.text: i did not appreciate that models would be able to create these awesome, rich, playable worlds that fuse knowledge and code.
kept_items.selection_reason: Karpathy first-hand reaction that current models can generate rich, playable 3D worlds - notable capability observation.

kept_items.author: karlmehta
kept_items.text: Demis Hassabis named two main AI risks and admitted the second has no fix yet: bad actors repurposing the technology, and a more general control worry.
kept_items.selection_reason: DeepMind CEO on the two principal AI risks, conceding the second is unsolved.

kept_items.text: David Sacks answered Dario Amodei warnings that open-source AI models are dangerous with a rhetorical question: Dangerous to whom?
kept_items.selection_reason: Captures the live open-source policy debate between Amodei and Sacks on the All-In podcast.
